name: Sulphites
aliases: E220, E221, E222, E223, E224, E225, E226, E227, E228, sulphites, sulfites, sulfur dioxide, sulphur dioxide, sodium sulfite, sodium sulphite, sodium bisulfite, sodium bisulphite, sodium hydrogen sulfite, sodium metabisulfite, sodium metabisulphite, potassium metabisulfite, potassium metabisulphite, potassium sulfite, potassium sulphite, calcium sulfite, calcium sulphite, calcium hydrogen sulfite, calcium hydrogen sulphite, potassium hydrogen sulfite, potassium hydrogen sulphite
what_is: A group of sulfur-based preservatives and antioxidants that includes sulfur dioxide and several sodium, potassium and calcium sulphite salts, identified in the EU as E220–E228.
why_botia: BOTIA groups these declarations because the same family can appear under an E-number or a chemical name. EU food-information rules also treat sulfur dioxide and sulphites above the specified threshold as substances requiring allergen-style declaration. That threshold cannot be reconstructed from an ingredient list alone.
can_1: Detect E220–E228 and the main sulphite/sulfite names when they are explicitly declared.
can_2: Explain that the family has both food-additive and EU food-information requirements without turning a positive declaration into a risk diagnosis.
cannot_1: Determine the residual sulfur dioxide concentration from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Conclude whether a product is below or above the EU declaration threshold when no analytical amount is provided.
